from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # X Z X |0> = X Z |1> = X (-|1>) = -|0>
    qc.x(0)
    qc.z(0)
    qc.x(0)
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # rz(2π) = -I, so |0> -> -|0>
    qc.rz(2 * math.pi, 0)
    return qc

from qiskit.circuit.library import GlobalPhaseGate

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # A global phase of pi implements -I on the whole circuit
    # |0> -> e^{i pi} |0> = -|0>
    qc.append(GlobalPhaseGate(math.pi), [])
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # A global phase of pi makes |0> -> e^{i pi}|0> = -|0>
    qc.global_phase = math.pi
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import UnitaryGate

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # diag(-1, 1) maps |0> -> -|0> and leaves |1> unchanged
    U = [[-1, 0],
         [ 0, 1]]
    qc.append(UnitaryGate(U), [0])
    return qc
